citations.title: What's in Mobile Update 10.0.70 | CompanyCam News Center
excerpts: # What's in Mobile Update 10.0.70
Shayla avatar
Shared by Shayla
• November 06, 2026

CompanyCam 10.0.70 is live on the Android and Apple app stores. You get a new photo editor, a cleaner, modern way to edit photos on the go, and you can now snap photos while you record video. Getting the shot you need also gets easier with new sharper detail or faster capture options. Photos you select for a Document now stay in the order you picked them, and restricted users can see the company photo feed, limited to their projects. Bug fixes and performance improvements round out the update.

basis.reasoning: CompanyCam's November 6, 2026 update announcement describes a new photo editor and other product features, inside the six-month lookback window.
